items.briefing:
A new malware operation called Gryxa was reportedly built with the help of AI tools, highlighting how cybercriminals are using AI to create threats faster and more effectively. Separately, users of the AI platform Anthropic (Claude) have been targeted by "infostealer" attacks that steal login sessions, meaning criminals can access accounts without needing a password. If your team uses AI tools for work, be aware that these platforms are increasingly being targeted.

Scam activity remains high across Australia — check the ACCC's Scamwatch for current alerts relevant to your area. **Practical tip:** If you use any AI platform for work, enable multi-factor authentication on your account to reduce the risk of unauthorised access.

featured.title: AI helped build Gryxa malware operation, report says
